items.briefing:
A reminder to be cautious about data breach claims circulating online — a recent analysis by security researcher Troy Hunt highlights how unverified breach reports can spread quickly and cause unnecessary alarm. Always check official sources before acting on claims that your organisation's data has been compromised. Meanwhile, CREST has launched a new AI testing standard for cybersecurity firms, which may affect how your organisation evaluates security vendors going forward.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an alert claiming your organisation has been involved in a data breach, report it to your IT or security team before sharing it further — don't assume it's legitimate.
